create_styler_renderer_html: create a StylerRenderer to format a DataFrame and render it as styled HTML output
build_styler_renderer_latex: build a StylerRenderer to format a DataFrame and render it as styled LaTeX tabular output
test_format_cells: test the StylerRenderer.format method to apply custom formatters, escaping, and hyperlink conversion to DataFrame cells
refactor_format_index: refactor the StylerRenderer.format_index method to apply formatters to MultiIndex level labels or column headers
summarize_tooltips: summarize the Tooltips class to generate hover tooltips with CSS pseudo-classes or HTML title attributes on DataFrame cells
